stories.title: Arabie saoudite : les houthistes du Yémen affirment avoir frappé l’aéroport de Ryad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Yemen's Houthis claim to have struck Riyadh airport
en.summary: Houthi forces from Yemen claimed responsibility for an attack on Saudi Arabian airports. Saudi Arabia reported three deaths resulting from Houthi attacks on its airports.

stories.title: Sébastien Lecornu accablé par « la superposition des crises », du mouvement lycéen à la baisse du pouvoir d’achat

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu overwhelmed by "the overlapping of crises", from student movements to declining purchasing power
en.summary: The Prime Minister addressed the nation regarding multiple concurrent challenges including student protests and economic difficulties. He indicated some understanding toward student concerns but stated he could not meet their main demands.

stories.title: États-Unis : le Texas procède à la première exécution depuis l’échec inédit de celle de Christa Pike

en.title: United States: Texas carries out first execution since unprecedented failure of Christa Pike's execution
en.summary: Texas executed Jamaal Howard, 46, for murder, marking the 30th execution in the United States since the beginning of the year. This followed a failed execution attempt.

stories.title: Apologie du terrorisme : trois mineurs en garde à vue à Orléans après une vidéo dans un lycée, mentionnant les attaques de Mohammed Merah et Salah Abdeslam

en.title: Apology for terrorism: three minors in custody in Orléans after a video in a high school mentioning attacks by Mohammed Merah and Salah Abdeslam
en.summary: Three minors were detained in Orléans following a video at a high school referencing terrorist attacks. An investigation was also opened in Vendée regarding a similar video filmed in a church.

stories.title: Christa Pike, qui a survécu à son exécution aux Etats-Unis, a repris connaissance et se dit "en colère et désorientée"

en.title: Christa Pike, who survived her execution in the United States, regained consciousness and says she is "angry and disoriented"
en.summary: A woman who survived an execution attempt in the US has regained consciousness following the failed procedure. The incident has reignited debate over capital punishment methods, particularly lethal injection.

stories.title: Espagne : la retraitée expulsée à l'origine des manifestations contre la crise du logement est morte

en.title: Spain: the retired woman evicted at the origin of demonstrations against the housing crisis has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman who had lived in her Madrid apartment for 70 years was evicted after it was purchased by a real estate agency. She subsequently became a focal point for housing crisis protests.

stories.title: Sur le point d’être débranchée, Christa Pike reprend connaissance après l’échec de son exécution par injection létale

en.title: On the verge of being disconnected, Christa Pike regains consciousness after failed lethal injection execution
en.summary: A Tennessee woman convicted of torture and murder regained consciousness while hospitalized in critical condition about a week after receiving two barbiturate injections during a failed execution.

stories.title: Espagne : Maricarmen, la retraitée devenue symbole de la crise du logement, est morte

en.title: Spain: Maricarmen, the retiree who became a symbol of the housing crisis, has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish retiree died following her eviction from a Madrid apartment on September 23. Her expulsion triggered widespread protests across Spain against the country's housing crisis.

stories.title: Espagne : Maricarmen Abascal, la retraitée expulsée à l’origine du mouvement de protestation sur le logement, est morte

en.title: Spain: Maricarmen Abascal, the evicted retiree at the origin of the housing protest movement, has died
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman was evicted from her Madrid apartment on September 23, sparking large-scale demonstrations across Spain regarding housing access issues.

stories.title: Maricarmen Abascal, la retraitée espagnole expulsée de son logement, à l'origine d'un immense mouvement de protestation, est morte

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal, the Spanish retiree evicted from her home, at the origin of a massive protest movement, has died
en.summary: An elderly Spanish woman who had lived in the same apartment for seven decades became a symbol of Spain's housing access problems when she was forced to leave. She has since died.

stories.title: Lycées, gazole, électricité, budget... Ce qu'il faut retenir de l'allocution du Premier ministre, Sébastien Lecornu

en.title: High schools, diesel, electricity, budget... What to remember from Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu's address
en.summary: The head of government promised to announce initial decisions by the end of October in response to high school student mobilization.

stories.title: Prix du gazole et de l’électricité : les mesures annoncées par Sébastien Lecornu ce mercredi

en.title: Diesel and electricity prices: measures announced by Sébastien Lecornu on Wednesday
en.summary: The Prime Minister spoke from Matignon following a meeting at the Élysée with Emmanuel Macron, after approximately 450,000 demonstrators protested nationwide on Tuesday regarding high school student concerns.

stories.title: Pourquoi le Groenland pousse le Danemark vers l'A400M d'Airbus

en.title: Why Greenland is pushing Denmark toward Airbus's A400M
en.summary: Denmark is considering the Airbus A400M military transport aircraft to replace its fleet of Lockheed Martin C130J planes, with Greenland's polar operations demonstrating the aircraft's capabilities in extreme conditions.

stories.title: Grève chez TotalEnergies : les raffineries et stations-service sous tension

en.title: Strike at TotalEnergies: refineries and service stations under pressure
en.summary: A strike called by the CGT labor union at TotalEnergies on October 8 targeting 35,000 French employees is expected to primarily impact refineries, service stations, and Hutchinson rubber manufacturing facilities.

stories.title: OPINION. « Budget 2027 : ne faisons pas des maires les comptables des économies de l'État »

en.title: OPINION. "Budget 2027: let's not make mayors the accountants of state savings"
en.summary: An opinion piece warns that continuously demanding more from local elected officials while reducing their decision-making authority risks preventing them from taking action in the future.

stories.title: Baisse de 12 à 18 centimes sur le gazole, électricité, mobilisation lycéenne… Ce qu’il faut retenir de l’allocution de Sébastien Lecornu

en.title: 12 to 18 cent reduction on diesel, electricity, student mobilization… What to remember from Sébastien Lecornu's address
en.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced measures addressing fuel and electricity prices while maintaining a goal to reduce public deficit to 5%, and responded to concerns raised by high school students.

stories.title: OPINION. « Écoles de la République, faire baisser la température ! »

en.title: OPINION. "Schools of the Republic, bring down the temperature!"
en.summary: An opinion piece discusses extreme heat waves during the previous school year that forced French schools to adjust schedules and temporarily close due to classroom conditions.
